summary.name: Ballpoint Pen Drawing
summary.visualIdentity: Explicit: thin blue-black or black lines, repeated contours, and dense-to-sparse hatching on clean white or lightly warm paper, with a sketchbook character. Heavy outlines and smooth vector fills are avoided. Marks are revealed in drawing order or as layered sketches.
summary.suitableUses: Explicit: sketchbook-style storytelling works alone. Inferred from generic catalog notes, not style-specific: product introductions, explanatory narratives, and chaptered sequences. Audience, duration, and aspect ratio are unspecified.
summary.limitations: Avoid heavy outlines and smooth vector fills. Keep paper and ink colors unchanged. Rough.js does not provide handwriting, pen pressure, paper texture, or character poses. Hachure does not establish authentic pencil or print media. Simulated appearance is not evidence of physical production.
summary.palette: Suggested, not supplied: background #FCFAF4 (lightly warm paper) and foreground #172C49 (blue-black ink). Both are monochrome roles, and gradients are disabled. Measured contrast is 13.477:1, a two-color check only. Task-supplied colors override these. Tone comes from hatching density, not added hues.
summary.motionAndInteraction: Marks reveal in plausible pen order, or layered sketches animate. Movement is restrained, with no random noise displacement. Any hold boil must use one fixed, slow cadence and never run while lines are still drawing. Interactive versions may reveal notes on focus or tap, with a static reduced-motion option.
summary.audio: Unspecified in this style record, so no audio is assigned. Per the audio direction, choose per task among restrained ambience, a light accent, music sync, or silence, with no mandatory layer. Inferred: a sparse, quiet bed suits the sketchbook pace. Speech must remain intelligible.
summary.assetRequirements: Contours and hatching are stored as SVG paths. Fine pen texture is composited in Canvas 2D. Fonts and assets must load before rendering. Rough.js needs stable nonzero integer seeds and cached geometry. Approved source artwork and exact copy stay intact. Specific fonts, paper textures, and source files are unspecified.
summary.combinations: Ballpoint works alone. Optional: style-024 adds same-pen margin notes and arrows, appearing only after the drawing completes. Optional: style-092 adds a subtle hold boil between two hatch-only variants. Avoid a second ink color, marker strokes, and boiling lettering. Motion references 012 and 015 are optional and may be declined.
summary.productionApproach: Style renderer: SVG paths plus Canvas 2D, with optional Rough.js for seeded geometry. Motion engine: one paused, seekable GSAP timeline, with Motion optional only after synchronization is verified. Pipeline: HyperFrames primary, and Remotion only under the documented fallback with the reason recorded. Validate with check and snapshot, then inspect frames before rendering.
